name: DA7-1-macOS-is-told-to-update-in-place
note: An unsigned mac app cannot swap itself; the updater would fail every launch, silently.

name: DA7-2-the-portable-exe-is-told-to-update-in-place
note: No app-update.yml inside a portable build: checkForUpdates throws ENOENT on every launch.

name: DA7-4-the-update-downloads-but-never-installs
note: The whole ask: the player does nothing. A downloaded installer nobody runs is the old notice with a bigger cache.

name: DA7-5-the-launch-always-takes-the-notice
old:
if (currentUpdateTransport() === 'updater') autoUpdater().checkForUpdates().catch(() => {});
    else checkForUpdates({ silent: true });

name: DA7-6-the-launch-check-escapes-the-gate
note: The checkbox and the probe env must hold BOTH transports - a probe that reaches GitHub is the thing DA6's gate exists to prevent.

name: DA7-7-the-release-drops-the-updater-metadata
note: Without latest.yml on the release the updater finds nothing and every copy silently stays where it is.

name: DA7-8-no-publish-provider-no-metadata-written
note: electron-builder writes latest.yml and app-update.yml only when a provider is configured, whatever --publish says.
